note: A small controlled vocabulary of reusable solution ideas. Each entry names a mechanism a solver can carry to another problem, not a broad subject. Broad subjects may filter a search but never justify a match on their own. Contains no private study content.

ideas.label: Invariant modulo a small integer
ideas.description: Track a quantity modulo a small integer that no allowed move changes, then show the target state has a different residue.

ideas.label: Monovariant or infinite descent
ideas.description: Exhibit a nonnegative integer quantity that strictly decreases under the process, so the process must terminate or no minimal counterexample can exist.

ideas.label: Extremal object and local contradiction
ideas.description: Choose a largest, smallest, or otherwise extreme configuration and derive a contradiction from a local improvement.

ideas.label: Count the same incidences two ways
ideas.description: Evaluate one quantity by two different groupings and equate the results.

ideas.label: Structured pigeonhole
ideas.description: Partition into carefully designed classes so that some class must contain two objects with the property you need.

ideas.label: Bijection with a simpler set
ideas.description: Construct an explicit correspondence with a set whose size is already known.

ideas.label: Encode a sequence in a generating function
ideas.description: Turn a recurrence or counting problem into an identity about a formal power series.

ideas.label: Recursion on an enriched state
ideas.description: Add information to the state so the recurrence closes.

ideas.label: Coloring or weighting argument
ideas.description: Assign colors or weights so that every allowed piece covers a fixed total, then compare totals.

ideas.label: Model the situation as a graph
ideas.description: Translate objects and relations into vertices and edges so a degree, connectivity, or matching argument applies.

ideas.label: Prove a quadrilateral is cyclic
ideas.description: Establish concyclicity to transfer angle relationships between parts of the figure.

ideas.label: Power of a point
ideas.description: Use equal products of signed lengths along lines through a fixed point relative to a circle.

ideas.label: Spiral similarity or rotation-homothety
ideas.description: Identify a single rotation-and-scaling mapping one segment to another and use its fixed point.

ideas.label: Homothety linking two figures
ideas.description: Find a center and ratio taking one circle or triangle to another, transferring tangency and collinearity.

ideas.label: Radical axis and radical center
ideas.description: Use equal power lines of pairs of circles to force concurrency.

ideas.label: Coordinates or complex numbers for a figure
ideas.description: Place the figure in coordinates or the complex plane so a synthetic claim becomes computation.

ideas.label: Trigonometric length and angle chase
ideas.description: Apply the law of sines or cosines repeatedly to reduce a configuration to an identity.

ideas.label: Compare areas to get ratios
ideas.description: Use shared heights or bases so area ratios yield segment ratios.

ideas.label: Normalize a homogeneous expression
ideas.description: Fix a convenient value of a homogeneous constraint before applying a bound.

ideas.label: Smoothing or adjustment to an extreme case
ideas.description: Move variables toward each other or toward a boundary without decreasing the objective, reducing to a simple case.

ideas.label: Convexity or Jensen's inequality
ideas.description: Recognize convexity of a well-chosen function and apply it to averages.

ideas.label: Choose the right Cauchy-Schwarz split
ideas.description: Pick the pairing of terms that makes Cauchy-Schwarz or its Engel form collapse to the target.

ideas.label: Rewrite as a sum of squares
ideas.description: Move everything to one side and exhibit a nonnegative sum-of-squares form.

ideas.label: Tangent line bound
ideas.description: Bound each term by its tangent line at the equality point, then sum.

ideas.label: Pair symmetric terms to expose a factorization
ideas.description: Group terms related by a symmetry so a common factor appears.

ideas.label: Substitution that removes a constraint
ideas.description: Change variables so a constraint becomes automatic or an expression becomes standard.

ideas.label: Argue from root structure of a polynomial
ideas.description: Use degree, multiplicity, or Vieta relations rather than expanding.

ideas.label: Targeted substitutions in a functional equation
ideas.description: Feed special values into the equation to pin down injectivity, a fixed point, or the value at zero.

ideas.label: Telescoping sum or product
ideas.description: Rewrite each term as a difference so almost everything cancels.

ideas.label: Multiplicative order and lifting the exponent
ideas.description: Use the order of a residue, Fermat's little theorem, or the lifting-the-exponent lemma to control divisibility.

ideas.label: Bound size against a divisibility constraint
ideas.description: Show a divisor must be large while the quantity is small, leaving finitely many cases.

ideas.label: Euclidean algorithm structure
ideas.description: Exploit that gcd is preserved under subtraction or reduction to characterize a sequence.

ideas.label: Construct an example, then prove optimality
ideas.description: Split an extremal problem into an explicit construction and a matching bound.

ideas.label: Strengthen the induction hypothesis
ideas.description: Prove a stronger statement because the original is too weak to carry the step.

ideas.label: Probabilistic or averaging existence argument
ideas.description: Show the average over a random choice already achieves the bound, so some choice does.

ideas.label: Parity of a position or permutation
ideas.description: Use the sign of a permutation or a parity of coordinates that the moves preserve.

ideas.label: Exhaustive boundary and degenerate case analysis
ideas.description: Isolate the finitely many degenerate configurations and handle them separately.

ideas.label: Continuity and the intermediate value theorem
ideas.description: Build a continuous function whose sign change forces the desired root or configuration.

ideas.label: Monotonicity via a derivative
ideas.description: Differentiate to show a single sign change, reducing to a limiting comparison.

ideas.label: Not enough evidence to name the idea
ideas.description: Reserved marker. Used when the available statement and work do not support a confident label; it lowers confidence rather than forcing a convincing-sounding tag.
